connections.description: External connections, one values layer per connection file. Not used by this chart.

okdp-lib-chart.description: Values slot Helm creates for the okdp-lib-chart library dependency. Not a parameter.

target.title: Target address
target.description: Address returned for every name under the ingress suffix (IPv4, or IPv6).

nodePort.title: Node port
nodePort.description: Node port of the DNS service, UDP and TCP.

forwarders.title: Forwarders
forwarders.description: Upstream DNS servers for the names outside the ingress suffix.

upstream.title: Upstream chart values
upstream.description: Values of the upstream chart this chart renders, merged over the values it computes: any upstream parameter can be set, except the ones the platform relies on. Maps merge, lists and scalars replace. No key or value may contain '{{'.

coredns.title: coredns
coredns.description: Values of the coredns chart 1.47.1 (https://coredns.github.io/helm), for example image, resources, nodeSelector, tolerations, zoneFiles, extra server blocks. Refused: fullnameOverride, nameOverride, deployment.enabled/skipConfig/name/selector, service.name, serviceType, isClusterService, rbac.create, hpa.enabled. Appended to the server blocks this chart computes: servers.

noTemplate.description: No key or string value, at any depth, contains '{{': upstream charts pass some values to tpl.
